为什么空运按每立方米 167 kg 计算？

Airlines charge on the higher / actual weight and volumetric weight. The IATA standard divides volume by 6000 cubic centimetres per kilogram, which equals 167 kg per cubic metre. Light, bulky cargo therefore costs much more by air than its weight suggests.
